fields.statement: At 83c71b7: make check passed (an earlier run's only failure was the timing-sensitive tui/modelapp read budget, which passed on rerun). Read the diff: build.toml gains a render step (build -> render -> check) that runs rhiza render, stages .rhiza/rendered and .rhiza/log, and commits 'Render after the build' with a Change: trailer when anything changed; ship-change drops its own render step and inherits build/render. Ran build-workflow.txtar in a scratch worktree with added assertions. After the built-in build run, the build worktree's HEAD is 'Render after the build' / Change: <change id>, committing 6 .rhiza/log entries and the rendered actor pages and index. git status --porcelain -- .rhiza is empty, rhiza check prints ok on the branch, and fold-ok passes.
